definitions.explanation: The humble or formal term for one's own grandmother. Used when speaking about your grandmother to others in polite contexts.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧です。
{祖母|そぼ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦{八十歳|はちじゅっさい}→八十歳：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother will turn 80 this year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧{祖母|そぼ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}します→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧。
examples.english: I call my grandmother every week.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{遠|とお}く→遠い：00529_tooi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいます→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{会|あ}いに→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother lives far away, so I often go to see her during summer vacation.
My grandmother was a teacher when she was young. She still likes reading books.

notes:
{祖母|そぼ} is the humble/formal term for one's own grandmother, used when speaking to others in polite or formal contexts.

FAMILY TERM REGISTER:
- {祖母|そぼ}: humble/formal (about your own grandmother)
- ⟦おばあさん→おばあさん：02863_obaasan⟧: neutral-polite (about someone else's grandmother)
- ⟦おばあちゃん→おばあちゃん：10968_obaachan⟧: casual/affectionate (direct address or about your own)
- ⟦おばあさま→おばあさま：noentry⟧: respectful (about someone else's grandmother)

COMPANION TERMS:
- ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧: grandfather (same humble/formal register)
- ⟦{祖父母|そふぼ}→祖父母：03110_sofubo⟧: grandparents

USAGE:
In writing, essays, and formal speech, {祖母|そぼ} is standard. In everyday conversation, most people say ⟦おばあちゃん→おばあちゃん：10968_obaachan⟧ when talking about their own grandmother.
⟦{外祖母|がいそぼ}→外祖母：noentry⟧ specifically means maternal grandmother, and ⟦{内祖母|ないそぼ}→内祖母：noentry⟧ means paternal grandmother, but these terms are rarely used in daily conversation.
